content.caption: Crispy Garlic Butter Toast: 4 thick slices bread, 3 tbsp softened butter, 4 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp chopped parsley, pinch of salt. Bake at 200°C for 10 mins!
content.transcript: Let's make the crispiest garlic butter bread toast. Mix softened butter with freshly minced garlic, chopped parsley, and a pinch of salt. Spread generously on crusty bread and bake at 200 degrees Celsius for 10 minutes until golden.

knowledge.title: Crispy Garlic Butter Toast Recipe
knowledge.summary: Quick and flavorful recipe for making crispy garlic butter toast baked to golden perfection.
steps: In a small bowl, combine softened butter, minced garlic, parsley, and salt.
Spread the garlic butter mixture evenly over the bread slices.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until crisp and golden brown around the edges.
tips: Use room temperature butter for easy spreading without tearing the bread.
Broil for the last 1 minute for extra crispness.
